mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_room_participant (chat_room_id, user_id, participant_role, participant_status) VALUES (#{chatRoomId}, #{userId}, #{participantRole}, #{participantStatus})
mapper.select: SELECT crp.chat_room_id, crp.user_id, u.nickname, crp.participant_role, crp.participant_status, crp.last_read_message_id, crp.muted_yn, crp.joined_at, crp.left_at, crp.created_at, crp.updated_at FROM chat_room_participant crp INNER JOIN users u ON crp.user_id = u.id WHERE crp.chat_room_id = #{chatRoomId} AND crp.participant_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY crp.joined_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_room_participant SET participant_status = 'ACTIVE', participant_role = 'MEMBER', left_at = NULL, joined_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE chat_room_id = #{chatRoomId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_room_participant WHERE chat_room_id = #{chatRoomId} AND participant_status = 'ACTIVE'
